claims.text: Defensive null checks have been added within the createMarkLineUpdater function.
The code checks if echartsInstance.getOption() returns a valid options object.
The code checks if the series property exists before attempting to access it.
The code checks if the markLine.data property exists before attempting to access it.
This prevents the TypeError by gracefully handling scenarios where the chart's state is not yet ready or is being torn down.
